title: redundant cast in encrypt.rs: (cek.as_ref() as &[u8]).to_vec()
description: encrypt.rs has two occurrences of: let cek_bytes: Vec<u8> = (cek.as_ref() as &[u8]).to_vec(); The explicit 'as &[u8]' cast is redundant because cek.as_ref() on a crypto_common::Key already returns &[u8]. Rewrite as: let cek_bytes = cek.as_ref().to_vec(); This is purely cosmetic noise but any contributor will wonder why the cast is there.
close_reason: cast is required for type disambiguation — crypto_common::Key implements multiple AsRef<T> impls; the explicit 'as &[u8]' is necessary, not redundant. Subagent's attempt to remove it broke compilation (E0282). Reverted to original.
